confirmation_comparators: same-batch sham, two independent nominally norm-matched random residual directions, one nominally norm-matched other channel; BF16 realized norms are not measured
confirmation_primary: selected signed dose, continuous intervention; no automated semantic endpoint or statistical discovery claim
coverage_definition: Every post-gating MLP down-projection input channel; attention heads and arbitrary residual directions are outside this census.
stop_behavior: At the wall limit, finish at most the active batch, persist partial progress, and exit. Unvisited channels remain untested. Resume the same frozen campaign.
calibration_prompts: Explain how a bicycle brake slows a wheel.
Summarize how a seed grows into a plant.
Explain why shadows change position during the day.
Give a short explanation of how a paper envelope is made.
Describe the steps involved in making a cup of tea.
Explain what a computer file is to a beginner.
Describe how a bridge supports the weight above it.
Explain the difference between a circle and a sphere.
